welcome.message: Explore how the Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante boundaries have been redrawn from 1996 to 2026, and what the redrawn land holds. Every layer names its publisher and vintage — see "About" below for full sources. Try asking:
examples: Overlay the Bears Ears boundary in 2016 and its 2026 proposed reduction.
How many acres did the 2026 proposal cut from Grand Staircase-Escalante compared with its 2021 extent?
How much of the Kaiparowits Plateau coal deposit falls outside the 2026 proposed Grand Staircase boundary?
Which protected areas and federal trails fall inside the 2026 proposed Bears Ears boundary?
